note: Typogrify provides a core text-format filter plugin (id: typogrify) plus a Twig |typogrify filter. There is no configure route (configure=null); you enable and tune it per text format under Text formats and editors. Its settings are stored at filter.format.<format> -> filters.typogrify.settings and covered by schema filter_settings.typogrify. Scalar toggles: smartypants_enabled, smartypants_hyphens (1/2/3), space_hyphens, wrap_ampersand, widont_enabled, space_to_nbsp, hyphenate_shy, wrap_abbr, wrap_caps, wrap_initial_quotes, wrap_numbers; serialized-map settings: ligatures, arrows, fractions, quotes. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real text-format config: introspection reads which format has typogrify enabled and a setting value; execution enables the filter on a format and sets space_hyphens. The Twig extension service is typogrify.twig_extension. Uses namespaced throwaway formats (typogrify_eval*).

evals.prompt: How do I switch on the typographic refinements from the typogrify module for content on my Drupal site? Is there a global settings page?
evals.expected_output: There is no global settings page (configure=null). Typogrify is a text-format filter: edit a text format at Configuration -> Content authoring -> Text formats and editors, enable the 'Typogrify' filter, and set its per-filter options. It applies to any content rendered through that format.

evals.prompt: Does typogrify offer a way to apply typographic refinements directly in a Twig template, and how would I apply just widow-prevention to a heading?
evals.expected_output: Yes. The typogrify.twig_extension adds a |typogrify Twig filter. Use {{ title|typogrify(['widont']) }} to apply only widow prevention; {{ text|typogrify }} with no options applies the full default pipeline. Valid options are amp, widont, smartypants, caps, initial_quotes, dash.

evals.prompt: Name several of the typographic refinements the typogrify filter can perform and a couple of the setting keys that toggle them.
evals.expected_output: It can produce smart quotes and en/em dashes (smartypants_enabled, smartypants_hyphens), prevent widows (widont_enabled), wrap ampersands (wrap_ampersand) and capital runs (wrap_caps) in styled spans, wrap initial quotes (wrap_initial_quotes), add non-breaking spaces before punctuation (space_to_nbsp), and convert ligatures/arrows/fractions/quotes.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, exactly one text format has the Typogrify filter enabled. Inspect the live filter-format configuration and tell me the machine name of that text format.
evals.expected_output: The text format 'typogrify_eval' has the Typogrify filter enabled (filter.format.typogrify_eval -> filters.typogrify.status = true).

evals.prompt: On this site the text format 'typogrify_eval2' has the Typogrify filter enabled with a specific dash-replacement mode configured. Inspect the live configuration and tell me the value of the Typogrify dash setting (smartypants_hyphens) on that format.
evals.expected_output: smartypants_hyphens is 2 on filter.format.typogrify_eval2 -> filters.typogrify.settings (mode 2 = '---' for em-dashes, '--' for en-dashes).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a text format with machine name 'typogrify_eval_h' that does not yet use Typogrify. Enable the Typogrify filter on that text format and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the typogrify filter on filter.format.typogrify_eval_h, e.g. $f = FilterFormat::load('typogrify_eval_h'); $f->setFilterConfig('typogrify', ['status' => TRUE, 'weight' => 10])->save(); so filters.typogrify.status is true.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the text format 'typogrify_eval_h2' already has the Typogrify filter enabled. Configure that filter so it also replaces stand-alone dashes (a normal dash surrounded by spaces) with em-dashes. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the Typogrify filter's space_hyphens setting to 1 on filter.format.typogrify_eval_h2 (filters.typogrify.settings.space_hyphens = 1), e.g. via setFilterConfig('typogrify', ['status'=>TRUE,'weight'=>10,'settings'=>['space_hyphens'=>1]])->save().
